`final class EventType<E extends Event>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [EventType.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/EventType.java)

The key of one kind of event in an event bus, such as the click of a node.

## Description

A node or a UI declares one `EventType` per event, in a static field, and passes it to `listen` and `fire`.
Two calls of `create` with the same name give two different types.
